deviation: The draft lets the Work Order override the Parent Agreement on Services, fees, term and milestones, and omits the SOW tier. The playbook requires the MSA to always prevail, so lower documents could dilute MSA terms. The carve-out is not clearly limited, and "Services" or "term" could be read to alter liability, IP, data protection or audit terms. The added entire-agreement clause could also supersede related documents.
suggested_text: This Work Order is issued under the Statement of Work and the Master Services Agreement named above. If there is a conflict, the Master Services Agreement prevails, then the Statement of Work, then this Work Order.
